name: Shakespeare's Code
source:
A witch is cursed by dark forces to become a monster. To save herself, she must reach a grim town and spill mortal blood. 

Time is running out – the pyres are already lit.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Shakespeare%27s_Code]romance-club.fandom[/url]
